Algorithm 6.8 (Feedback vertex set)
1. Decomposition phase
    \( H \leftarrow G, w' \leftarrow w, i \leftarrow 0 \)
    While H is not acyclic,
    \( c \leftarrow \min_{u \in H} \left\{ \frac{w'(u)}{\delta_H(u)} \right\} \)
    \( G_i \leftarrow H, t_i \leftarrow c \cdot \delta_{G_i}, w' \leftarrow w' - t_i \)
    \( H \leftarrow \) the subgraph of \( G_i \) induced by vertices u with \( w'(u) > 0 \)
    \( i \leftarrow i + 1, \)
    \( k \leftarrow i, G_k \leftarrow H \)
2. Extension phase
    \( F_k \leftarrow \emptyset \)
    For \( i = k, \ldots, 1 \), extend \( F_i \) to a feedback vertex set \( F_{i-1} \) of \( G_{i-1} \) by adding a minimal set of vertices from \( V_{i-1} - V_i \).
    Output \( F_0 \).
